content: Self-service cancellation norms: cancel link belongs under Billing/Subscription/Account Settings, reachable in <=2 clicks. Default model across SaaS is cancel-at-period-end with no refund - access continues to the paid-through date. Must state the exact final date at the moment of cancellation ('active until [date], will not renew') and send an immediate confirmation email containing a reactivate link. Structured cancellation flows (reason capture, offers) retain 15-25% of would-be cancellers vs near-zero for instant no-friction cancel, but dark-pattern retention is legally risky.
